name: News and releases
description: Headlines from BBC News's RSS feeds and a GitHub project's releases from its Atom feed. An example of an http adapter that reads feeds with parseFeed: RSS and Atom from two hosts, no login.

tools.name: get_headlines
tools.title: Get headlines
tools.description: The latest headlines from one section of BBC News (top stories, world, UK, business, technology, science, health or entertainment): each one's title, link, time and summary.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.title: List releases
tools.description: A GitHub project's latest releases, from its public releases feed: each one's tag, link, date and notes as plain text.
